_comment: SC-072 / RA-06b — canvas mode camera obeys all 6 bounds from computeCanvasCameraRail. The implementer must expose window.__PRISM_EDITOR_GET_CANVAS_CAMERA__ returning {position:{x,y,z}, target:{x,y,z}, polarAngle, azimuthAngle} for this interaction. Without it the 'has-camera-hook' assertion fails, flagging the missing surface to the worker.

steps.js: (() => { const set = window.__PRISM_EDITOR_SET_VIEW_MODE__; if (typeof set === 'function') set('canvas'); return 'requested-canvas'; })()

(() => { const get = window.__PRISM_EDITOR_GET_CANVAS_CAMERA__; const before = get(); for (let i = 0; i < 30; i += 1) { window.dispatchEvent(new WheelEvent('wheel', { deltaY: 1000, bubbles: true })); } return before; })()

(() => { const get = window.__PRISM_EDITOR_GET_CANVAS_CAMERA__; const rail = window.__PRISM_EDITOR_GET_CANVAS_RAIL__?.(); const cam = get(); if (!rail || !cam) return false; const distance = Math.hypot(cam.position.x - cam.target.x, cam.position.y - cam.target.y, cam.position.z - cam.target.z); return distance >= rail.minDistance - 0.01 && distance <= rail.maxDistance + 0.01 && cam.polarAngle >= rail.minPolarAngle - 0.01 && cam.polarAngle <= rail.maxPolarAngle + 0.01 && cam.azimuthAngle >= rail.minAzimuthAngle - 0.01 && cam.azimuthAngle <= rail.maxAzimuthAngle + 0.01; })()
